payload.comment: Data audit stage is clean. All 11 deterministic checks pass (official_split, train/val indices, labels, pixels, shape, train-validation disjointness). Key verifications: (1) Archive MD5 a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1 matches the verified hash; SHA-256 recorded. (2) Loaded split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) exactly match official PathMNIST sizes. (3) Image shape 28×28×3 RGB, 9-class multi-class — consistent with the standard MedMNIST distribution. (4) train_validation_overlap=0, test_inspected=false, train_stats_only=true — no leakage. (5) 100,000 samples profiled (89996+10004), zero duplicates, zero blank images. (6) Class proportions between train and val are tightly aligned (max absolute deviation <0.001), confirming no split-level distribution shift. (7) Imbalance ratio 1.63 is modest. (8) Normalization stats (per-channel mean/std) computed from train only. (9) Augmented train size 359984 = 89996×4 is arithmetically correct. Minor non-blocking observations: (a) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 across all stages, so LLM-assisted planning steps are not fully content-addressed for reproducibility; (b) two extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain pending_review in the extension gate — ensure hash-bound review is completed before training begins; (c) test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio is empty, so cross-domain prevalence shift is unquantified (expected dataset property). None of these are deterministic failures. Proceed to next stage.
